description: Compute the effective bulk price for a given product and quantity: applies the product's quantity-discount tiers and GST, validates the minimum order quantity, and shows the next discount tier. Pass options to price a choice other than the default (e.g. UV printing, which can add an extra per unit). Indicative pricing — final quotes come from the sales team.

options.description: Optional choices from get-product-details options, e.g. ["Print Type: UV"] (or just ["UV"]). Omit for the defaults.

slug.description: Product permalink slug or id (from search-products)

name: calculate-bulk-price
